Here you can change how the sources are ordered. If a video has a higher priority it will appear higher in the source selection. The sum of the source priority and the quality priority is the video priority.

Quality B: 7 
Will have a combined video priority of 10.


NOTE: If the sum is 10 or more the player will automatically skip loading when that link is loaded!
